{"type_map": {},
  "constraints": [
    {"id": "R1", "category": "count_semantics",
     "alternatives": ["df['sloss'] <= df['spkts']"],
     "features": ["sloss", "spkts"],
     "rationale": "The number of source packets retransmitted or dropped cannot exceed the total number of source packets sent."},
    {"id": "R2", "category": "count_semantics",
     "alternatives": ["df['dloss'] <= df['dpkts']"],
     "features": ["dloss", "dpkts"],
     "rationale": "The number of destination packets retransmitted or dropped cannot exceed the total number of destination packets received."},
    {"id": "R3", "category": "count_semantics",
     "alternatives": ["df['ct_flw_http_mthd'] <= df['spkts']"],
     "features": ["ct_flw_http_mthd", "spkts"],
     "rationale": "Each HTTP method (GET, POST) appears in a source-to-destination packet, so the count of methods cannot exceed the total source packet count."},
    {"id": "R4", "category": "count_semantics",
     "alternatives": ["df['ct_ftp_cmd'] <= df['spkts']"],
     "features": ["ct_ftp_cmd", "spkts"],
     "rationale": "Each FTP command is carried in a source-to-destination packet on the control channel, so the command count cannot exceed the total source packet count."},
    {"id": "R5", "category": "count_semantics",
     "alternatives": ["df['ct_src_dport_ltm'] <= df['ct_src_ltm']"],
     "features": ["ct_src_dport_ltm", "ct_src_ltm"],
     "rationale": "Connections matching the same source AND destination port form a subset of connections matching the same source address alone."},
    {"id": "R6", "category": "count_semantics",
     "alternatives": ["df['ct_dst_src_ltm'] <= df['ct_src_ltm']"],
     "features": ["ct_dst_src_ltm", "ct_src_ltm"],
     "rationale": "Connections matching the same source AND destination address form a subset of connections matching the same source address alone."},
    {"id": "R7", "category": "count_semantics",
     "alternatives": ["df['ct_dst_src_ltm'] <= df['ct_dst_ltm']"],
     "features": ["ct_dst_src_ltm", "ct_dst_ltm"],
     "rationale": "Connections matching the same source AND destination address form a subset of connections matching the same destination address alone."},
    {"id": "R8", "category": "count_semantics",
     "alternatives": ["df['ct_dst_sport_ltm'] <= df['ct_dst_ltm']"],
     "features": ["ct_dst_sport_ltm", "ct_dst_ltm"],
     "rationale": "Connections matching the same destination AND source port form a subset of connections matching the same destination address alone."},
    {"id": "R9", "category": "count_semantics",
     "alternatives": ["df['ct_srv_src'] <= df['ct_src_ltm']"],
     "features": ["ct_srv_src", "ct_src_ltm"],
     "rationale": "Connections matching the same service AND source address form a subset of connections matching the same source address alone."},
    {"id": "R10", "category": "count_semantics",
     "alternatives": ["df['ct_srv_dst'] <= df['ct_dst_ltm']"],
     "features": ["ct_srv_dst", "ct_dst_ltm"],
     "rationale": "Connections matching the same service AND destination address form a subset of connections matching the same destination address alone."},
    {"id": "R11", "category": "count_semantics",
     "alternatives": ["df['ct_state_ttl'] <= df['spkts'] + df['dpkts']"],
     "features": ["ct_state_ttl", "spkts", "dpkts"],
     "rationale": "The count of packets falling into specific TTL state ranges cannot exceed the total number of packets in the flow."}
  ]
}
